cuda.runtime: record torch.version.cuda; validate the matching bundled bnb binary

python.constraint: record actual runtime; no backend Python constraint

pytorch.installation: Kaggle-provided; do not replace or downgrade

restart_policy: If packages change after bitsandbytes has been imported, use Kernel > Restart Session and then Run All from the first cell.

revision_verification.cache_resolution: Use the pinned full commit directly; do not resolve mutable refs. Verify both lexical and resolved snapshots paths.
incomplete_snapshot_checks: model weight file or index and all referenced shards
all snapshot symlinks resolve to existing targets
revision_verification.metadata_source: HfApi.model_info.sha plus the commit directory returned by snapshot_download
revision_verification.model_and_tokenizer_loading: Load both from the same verified local snapshot with local_files_only=true.
